esati: Esati [ā + iṣ1 with confusion of iṣ1 and iṣ2, icchati, see also ajjhesati, anvesati, pariyesati] 탐구하다, 찾다, ~에 힘쓰다 Sn 592 (esāno ppr. med.), 919; Dh 131.
esanā: Esanā (f.) [fr. esati] 욕망, 갈망, 소망 D III.216, 270; M I.79; S V.54, 139; A I.93; II.41; V.31; VvA 83; PvA 98, 163, 265. See also anesanā, isi & pariy°.
esanī: Esanī (f.) [fr. iṣ] 의사의 진찰 M II.256.
esabha: Esabha (--°) a by--form of usabha (q. v.), in cpd. rathesabha.
esika: Esika (nt.) & Esikā 1 (f.) [a by--form of isīkā] 기둥, 말뚝 A IV.106, 109. 빈번히 °ṭṭhāyin 결합에, 기둥처럼 든든한 D I.14; S III.202, 211, 217; DA I.105.
esin: Esin (adj.) [Sk. eṣin, of iṣ] 탐색하는, 바라는, 욕심내는 S II.11 (sambhav°); J I.87 (phal°); IV.26 (dukkham°); Pv II.928 (gharam); PvA 132.
